items.title: Oracle Just Shipped 1,449 Security Patches in One Quarter. We Checked How Much of It Is Actually New. | UpGuard
items.summary: Oracle's July 2026 update shipped 1,449 security patches — 2.8x its all-time record. We parsed 23 quarters of advisories to find out how much is truly new.
